properties.rationale: Standing disposition for planned-but-unbuilt capabilities (user's 2026-07-23 call, applied again 2026-07-24). The check this needs, named now because the obvious one would pass while missing the point: a fixture where a REGISTERED artifact grows a new capability must report understatement, and must be distinguishable from the same artifact having a typo fixed — today both are checksum_change, and a test that only asserts "drift was detected" would pass on both and prove nothing about direction. A second case should assert the report names WHAT the design now claims wrongly, not merely that bytes moved, since the whole failure mode is that a human is told the design is stale without being told what to fix and therefore does not fix it. This capability's real validation is a field one and belongs to the trials programme: run it against storyflow, where the understatement was observed, and see whether it names the same delta a person would.
